# `skewness`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
skewness(expr)
```

Returns the skewness value calculated from values of a group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.6.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- skewness, example 1
> SELECT skewness(col) FROM VALUES (-10), (-20), (100), (1000) AS tab(col);
1.1135657469022011
```

```sql
-- skewness, example 2
> SELECT skewness(col) FROM VALUES (-1000), (-100), (10), (20) AS tab(col);
-1.113565746902201
```
